{{Quote|Five credits says that "Professor Gryphomarn" is Marn Hierogryph. He used to run rackets for B'Gallo.|Nunk Plaarvin, betting on Gryphomarn's identity|<ref name="KOTOR36">[[Knights of the Old Republic 36|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 36]]</ref>}}
'''B'Gallo''' was an individual that the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Marn Hierogryph]] ran [[Racketeering|rackets]] for at some point.<ref name="KOTOR36" /> Around [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="KOTOR36Date">[[Knights of the Old Republic 36|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 36]] states that the story occurs approximately 3963 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Hierogryph&mdash;under the alias [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] Gryphomarn&mdash;attempted to con the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] criminal [[Nunk Plaarvin]]. The Chevin, however, saw through the scheme and bet five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with his [[Chev]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individual [[Cipiter]] on the true identity of "Gryphomarn," mentioning Hierogryph's history with B'Gallo.<ref name="KOTOR36" />

==Behind the scenes==
B'Gallo was mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 36|thirty-sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KOTOR36" /> on [[December 24]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54355/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_36|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #36}}</ref>
